propositions: binding_store.py at 787/800 LOC has 13 lines of headroom before exceeding the CI module-size cap, creating risk that the next contributor breaks the build

the file contains two distinct concerns: binding lifecycle (bulk of the file) and last-synced peer state (ADR-0026 baseline + peer-parent evidence, ~130 LOC with docstrings), warranting extraction along the existing seam

extraction must preserve BindingStore's public surface (thin delegating methods on the store, all call sites unchanged) while allowing peer-state functions to be directly unit-testable without constructing a BindingStore

the peer-state cluster (_BASELINE_FIELDS, five functions, ~135 LOC) forms a cohesive, independently consumable concern with its own ADR and absence semantics (absent baseline degrades to local-wins, absent peer-parent to NO clear)
the new peer_state.py module must exceed 100 LOC and binding_store.py must drop below 700 LOC to satisfy the module-size policy

extraction was completed in Gerrit change 1364 (commit 0d1c92a1027ebf0470c3690d127f3cf65ce1a37c): peer_state.py 135 LOC, binding_store.py 699 LOC, all 6 acceptance criteria met, reconciler unit/integration suites passing, absence semantics pinned by new direct tests
